locator: I q.103 a.6 co.: the design of government, which is providence itself; and the execution of the design
interpretation: Government has two parts, the design (providence) and its execution; as to the design God governs all things immediately. Read as: a director moved by none directs by its own design, not as executing another's, and providence belongs to knowledge and intellect, so such a director knows and understands. Interpretive: it attributes the design to whatever director is first in the series, where a.6 attributes it to God. Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
